paths.description: Homepage: primary news discovery template and global navigation, privacy, performance, preference, and responsive checks.
Representative article: core reading, metadata, progressive enhancement, layout stability, and date semantics.
Representative politics listing: section/index template and responsive module behavior.
Primary search journey using the site form action and an Arabic query.

findings.summary: Responsive no horizontal scroll is not adequately supported.
findings.evidence: At a requested 360px viewport the page declares meta viewport width=1190 and Chrome lays out a 1250 CSS-pixel canvas scaled to 0.288.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace width=1190 with width=device-width and implement fluid breakpoints that reflow to one column.

findings.summary: No intrusive interruptions is not adequately supported.
findings.evidence: A consent interstitial dims and blocks the full homepage, section, and article before the reader can use the content.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep content usable while consent is offered; avoid a full-page blocking interruption.

findings.summary: Primary flow completion is not adequately supported.
findings.evidence: The exercised search URL remained on a loading spinner with no results or actionable recovery after the wait window.
findings.suggestedFix: Return search results reliably and expose an explicit empty/error result when the request fails.

findings.summary: Clear system state and recovery is not adequately supported.
findings.evidence: Search shows an indefinite spinner without empty/error explanation, retry action, or completion state.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace the indefinite spinner with aria-live loading, timeout, error text, and Retry.

findings.summary: Good core web vitals is not adequately supported.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 3.4s, FCP 2.5s, TBT 200ms, Speed Index 6.8s, and performance score 0.79.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP content, cut redirects/third-party startup, and keep long work off the critical path.

findings.summary: Visual stability is not adequately supported.
findings.evidence: Article layout observer measured CLS 0.158, including shifts of 0.0617 and 0.0928.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve dimensions for article media, ads, and injected modules before they load.

findings.summary: Efficient resource delivery is not adequately supported.
findings.evidence: HAR captured 249 requests and 2.80MB transferred; seven parser-inserted stylesheets and one synchronous head script were confirmed as render-blocking candidates.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline critical CSS, defer non-critical CSS/scripts, remove the synchronous head bundle, and set explicit priorities.

findings.summary: Names roles labels is not adequately supported.
findings.evidence: Probe found 7 unlabeled form controls, 19 empty links, and one unnamed button despite image alt coverage.
findings.suggestedFix: Add programmatic labels/names to every input, link, and button.

findings.summary: Legible text is not adequately supported.
findings.evidence: Body text is 14px on a fixed 1190px layout scaled to 28.8% at 360px, making text and controls visually tiny.
findings.suggestedFix: Reflow at device width and use a readable responsive type scale and line length.

findings.summary: Zoom reflow targets and media is not adequately supported.
findings.evidence: The fixed meta viewport width=1190 prevents mobile reflow and 87 visible controls are under 24px.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow device-width reflow and enlarge targets while preserving user zoom.

findings.summary: Secure transport and headers is not adequately supported.
findings.evidence: HTTPS is used, but CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame protection, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy are all absent.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy HSTS, CSP, nosniff, frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: Data minimisation and third parties is not adequately supported.
findings.evidence: Tracker capture found 25 third-party origins and six known tracker domains; HAR attributed 209 requests and 2.51MB to third parties.
findings.suggestedFix: Inventory vendors, remove nonessential trackers, delay optional analytics until consent, and reduce data retention.

findings.summary: Defensive browser policies is not adequately supported.
findings.evidence: All inspected defensive response policies were absent and three analytics/consent cookies lacked Secure while using SameSite=None for about 390-400 days.
findings.suggestedFix: Add defensive headers and mark HTTPS cookies Secure with appropriate SameSite and lifetime.

findings.summary: Progressive enhancement is not adequately supported.
findings.evidence: Article discoverability found only 8% content-token overlap without JavaScript and classified the rendered article as a JS shell.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render the complete article body and essential navigation, then enhance with JavaScript.

findings.summary: Optimised assets is not adequately supported.
findings.evidence: All 100 sampled images use legacy PNG/GIF/JPEG; 75 lack srcset, 89 below-fold images are not lazy-loaded, and 13 lack dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP responsive srcsets, lazy-load below-fold media, and add width/height.

findings.summary: Third party and media budget is not adequately supported.
findings.evidence: Third parties account for 2.51MB and 209 requests, with ad-tech, analytics, and bidding origins dominating the load.
findings.suggestedFix: Set and enforce a third-party request/byte budget; remove or defer ad-tech bidders.

findings.summary: Structured agent capabilities is not adequately supported.
findings.evidence: The public publisher allows major AI crawlers but exposes no WebMCP/tool declarations, while article no-JS content coverage is only 8%.
findings.suggestedFix: Expose complete server-rendered article content and machine-readable agent capabilities where useful.

findings.summary: Respects color scheme is not adequately supported.
findings.evidence: Emulated dark mode matched, but computed body colors remained rgb(195,30,30)/rgb(51,51,51) and color-scheme remained normal.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and retint surfaces/text with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Respects contrast is not adequately supported.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found insufficient foreground/background contrast, and prefers-contrast: more produced no theme response.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix failing color pairs to WCAG contrast and add a prefers-contrast enhancement.

findings.summary: View transitions is not adequately supported.
findings.evidence: DOM and animation probes across navigation-heavy news templates found no View Transition usage or equivalent continuity.
findings.suggestedFix: Use progressive View Transitions for same-site article and section navigation.

findings.summary: Physical gestures is not adequately supported.
findings.evidence: The dense carousel/navigation UI exposes many tiny controls (87 visible targets below 24px) rather than touch-sized, direct manipulation controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase direct-manipulation and carousel controls to at least 44 CSS px with touch-safe spacing.

findings.summary: Scroll state aware chrome is not adequately supported.
findings.evidence: Long pages (homepage CSS height 10,936px; article 7,091px) provide no visible progress or adaptive reading chrome.
findings.suggestedFix: Add lightweight reading progress or adaptive sticky chrome on long articles.

findings.summary: Reduced chrome is not adequately supported.
findings.evidence: The mobile screenshot is a scaled 1190px desktop portal with dense navigation, ads, tickers, sidebars, and dozens of competing story modules.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove competing chrome and ads from the initial reading viewport; establish one clear content column.

findings.summary: Component level responsiveness is not adequately supported.
findings.evidence: Homepage, section, article, and search all retain roughly 1190-1250px desktop component geometry at 360px instead of reflowing.
findings.suggestedFix: Use grid/flex intrinsic sizing and container queries so modules adapt to their available width.

findings.summary: Input modality aware is not adequately supported.
findings.evidence: Probe found 87 visible controls below 24px and the focused search input computed outline-style none.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore :focus-visible styles and enlarge pointer targets to at least 44px where practical.

findings.summary: Efficient main thread is not adequately supported.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported 2.3s main-thread work, TBT 200ms, and time-to-interactive 15.3s.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer non-critical scripts and split/schedule long startup work.

findings.summary: Trim unused and duplicate code is not adequately supported.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 503KiB unused JavaScript plus 14KiB unused CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split by template and remove unused CSS/JS and duplicate vendor functionality.

findings.summary: Sufficient contrast is not adequately supported.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse color-contrast audit failed on rendered content.
findings.suggestedFix: Update failing foreground/background tokens to WCAG-compliant contrast.

findings.summary: Structure and focus is not adequately supported.
findings.evidence: Homepage heading sample begins with many navigation H2 elements before content, 19 links have no accessible name, and focused search has no visible outline.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a content-first heading outline and restore strong keyboard focus indicators.

findings.summary: No console errors is not adequately supported.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse errors-in-console audit scored 0 and DevTools Issues were logged.
findings.suggestedFix: Resolve runtime exceptions and Chrome Inspector issues before release.

findings.summary: Sound document and assets is not adequately supported.
findings.evidence: Although doctype and UTF-8 are present, 13 images lack dimensions and Lighthouse found incorrect image aspect ratios.
findings.suggestedFix: Add intrinsic image dimensions and preserve source aspect ratios.

findings.summary: Browser platform hygiene is not adequately supported.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported a deprecated API warning and failed its Inspector Issues audit.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace deprecated APIs and resolve DevTools Issues findings.

findings.summary: Crawlable and mobile friendly is not adequately supported.
findings.evidence: Robots permits major crawlers and links are real anchors, but meta viewport width=1190 makes all representative templates non-mobile-friendly.
findings.suggestedFix: Retain crawlable anchors but fix the viewport and mobile reflow.

findings.summary: Resilient runtime behaviour is not adequately supported.
findings.evidence: Search stayed indefinitely in a spinner state and Lighthouse recorded console/Inspector errors, showing weak degraded runtime behavior.
findings.suggestedFix: Add bounded loading and explicit runtime failure/recovery states.

findings.summary: Network and http failure states is not adequately supported.
findings.evidence: The search journey exposes no timeout, retry, stale-results, or explanatory failure state when results do not resolve.
findings.suggestedFix: Handle timeout/offline/HTTP failure with retry and stale or empty results.

findings.summary: Locale aware data is not adequately supported.
findings.evidence: Visible Arabic publication dates are plain text with no time/datetime semantics, limiting locale-aware parsing and reformatting.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap publication dates in time elements with ISO datetime values and format with Intl.

findings.summary: Time zone correctness is not adequately supported.
findings.evidence: Article dates have no machine-readable datetime or timezone even though Open Graph uses UTC, leaving visible event time ambiguous for automation.
findings.suggestedFix: Include an ISO 8601 datetime with explicit offset and display the publication timezone.

findings.summary: Humane error handling is not adequately supported.
findings.evidence: Search can remain on a spinner without an error explanation, recovery action, or accessible status announcement.
findings.suggestedFix: Announce search state and provide specific, recoverable error guidance.

findings.summary: Trustworthy input assistance is not adequately supported.
findings.evidence: The search input has no label and no autocomplete value, so assistive technology and input assistance receive no purpose cue.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a visible search label and autocomplete="off" or the appropriate search purpose metadata.

findings.summary: No wasteful work is not adequately supported.
findings.evidence: The homepage loads 249 requests, including 209 third-party requests, before the reader interacts; Lighthouse also found 503KiB unused JavaScript.
findings.suggestedFix: Gate optional scripts on consent/visibility and remove unused startup code and requests.

findings.summary: Bounded footprint is not adequately supported.
findings.evidence: Baseline heap contained 571,554 nodes and 31.30MB self size on a document page, alongside 249 requests and extensive third-party code.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce loaded modules, DOM volume, and third-party runtimes on initial article/home loads.
